    • ggwave_encode

      int ggwave_encode(int instance, byte[] dataBuffer, int dataSize, int txProtocolId, int volume, byte[] outputBuffer, int query)
      Encodes an audio payload into the supplied output buffer.
      Parameter:
      instance - initialized ggwave instance identifier
      dataBuffer - encoded data to transmit
      dataSize - number of valid bytes in dataBuffer
      txProtocolId - transmission protocol identifier
      volume - output volume level
      outputBuffer - buffer receiving the encoded audio samples
      query - whether the operation is a query
      Gibt zurück:
      number of bytes written to outputBuffer, or the native error code

    • ggwave_decode

      int ggwave_decode(int instance, byte[] dataBuffer, int dataSize, byte[] outputBuffer)
      Decodes audio samples from the supplied input buffer.
      Parameter:
      instance - initialized ggwave instance identifier
      dataBuffer - input audio samples
      dataSize - number of valid bytes in dataBuffer
      outputBuffer - buffer receiving decoded payload bytes
      Gibt zurück:
      number of bytes written to outputBuffer, or the native error code
